title: State-DAG test coverage before case lists

steps.action: Derive the product's state DAG first; the first artifact of a test plan is the state graph, not a case list
Derive cases from edges and unreachable-state claims; every illegal transition gets a negative test
Group suites by state type and keep different state families in separate serial batches with concurrency inside a family
On failure, walk the full failure-analysis procedure before fixing; a probe is evidence collection, never a conclusion

decision_hooks.criteria: The dispatched task authors or repairs end-to-end or integration test suites
